description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Network Flow Monitor service, including method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, and querying monitors and scopes.

classes.name: NetworkFlowMonitorClient
classes.description: A client class that provides methods to interface with the AWS Network Flow Monitor service.

methods.name: createMonitor
methods.description: Creates a new network flow monitor.

methods.name: createMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new network flow monitor.

methods.name: createScope
methods.description: Creates a new scope within the monitor.

methods.name: createScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new scope.

methods.name: deleteMonitor
methods.description: Deletes an existing monitor.

methods.name: deleteMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a monitor.

methods.name: deleteScope
methods.description: Deletes an existing scope.

methods.name: deleteScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a scope.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific monitor.

methods.name: getMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves monitor information.

methods.name: getQueryResultsMonitorTopContributors
methods.description: Gets query results for monitor top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryResultsMonitorTopContributorsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves query results for monitor top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryResultsWorkloadInsightsTopContributors
methods.description: Retrieves data for workload insights top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryResultsWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for workload insights top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryResultsWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsData
methods.description: Fetches detailed workload insights top contributors data.

methods.name: getQueryResultsWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsDataAsync
methods.description: Async version for fetching workload insights data.

methods.name: getQueryStatusMonitorTopContributors
methods.description: Checks status of monitor top contributors query.

methods.name: getQueryStatusMonitorTopContributorsAsync
methods.description: Async status check for monitor top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryStatusWorkloadInsightsTopContributors
methods.description: Checks status for workload insights top contributors.

methods.name: getQueryStatusWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsAsync
methods.description: Async status check for workload insights.

methods.name: getQueryStatusWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsData
methods.description: Checks status for workload insights data query.

methods.name: getQueryStatusWorkloadInsightsTopContributorsDataAsync
methods.description: Async status for workload insights data query.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific scope.

methods.name: getScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves scope.

methods.name: listMonitors
methods.description: Lists all monitors.

methods.name: listMonitorsAsync
methods.description: Async listing of monitors.

methods.name: listScopes

methods.name: listScopesAsync
methods.description: Async listing of scopes.

methods.name: listTagsForResource

methods.description: Async start of monitor top contributors query.
